summary:
MongoDB 上季 EPS 1.65 美元超預期12.1%、營收 6.951 億美元，Atlas 動能延續。
• EPS 1.65 美元，超預期 12.08%，獲利亮眼
• 營收 6.951 億美元，Atlas 持續貢獻
• 雲端資料庫採用與客戶擴張
• AI 應用題材支撐長期需求
ai_view:
訊號正向：EPS 大幅超預期顯示獲利槓桿浮現，Atlas 雲端動能延續。短期財報利多支撐股價。中期關鍵在 Atlas 消費動能、AI 工作負載帶來的增量需求、客戶留存與大型客戶數成長，以及獲利率持續改善。估值依賴成長兌現，須觀察消費型營收環比動能與景氣敏感度。

需留意：本期未提供營收年增率，成長能見度有限；消費型營收的景氣敏感度；競爭加劇與獲利仍在成長期，無本益比

summary_en:
MongoDB beat EPS at $1.65 by 12.1% on $695.1M revenue, with Atlas momentum continuing.
• EPS of $1.65 beat by 12.08%, a strong showing
• Revenue of $695.1M with continued Atlas contribution
• Cloud database adoption and customer expansion
• AI application theme supports long-term demand

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: the large EPS beat shows operating leverage emerging, with Atlas momentum continuing. Near term the beat supports the stock. Mid term, the keys are Atlas consumption momentum, incremental demand from AI workloads, retention and large-customer growth, and continued margin improvement. Valuation depends on growth delivery, so watch sequential consumption momentum and macro sensitivity.

Watch：Revenue YoY not provided, limiting growth visibility; Macro sensitivity of consumption revenue; Intensifying competition; profitability maturing, no P/E
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超預期 12.08%，獲利優於估計（營收年增率未提供）。
